privacy.title: Kaupapa Here Tūmataiti
privacy.description: Te āhua o te whakahaere a I Need Convert i ō raraunga me ō kōnae. Ka hurihia ngā kōnae i tō pūtirotiro, ā, kāore rawa e tukuna ake ki ō mātou tūmau.
privacy.body:
Ko I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com) he taputapu kore utu hei huri i ngā whakaahua, ngā ataata, ngā oro, ngā tuhinga, ngā PDF, ngā ripanga (spreadsheet) me ngā raraunga, ā, e whakahaerehia ana e Abid Hanan Wicaksono. E whakamārama ana tēnei kaupapa here i ngā raraunga ka tukatukahia ina whakamahi koe i tēnei paetukutuku, me te āhua o tā mātou whakahaere i aua raraunga. He mea ā-whakaaro tā mātou kohi i te iti rawa o ngā raraunga e taea ana: kāore koe e hiahia ki te rēhita, ki te takiuru, ki te hoatu rānei i tō ingoa me tō īmēra kia whakamahi ai koe i tēnei ratonga.

Ngā kōnae ka hurihia e koe

Ka mahia ngā hurihanga katoa i roto tonu i tō pūtirotiro. Ko tō pūrere anō e pānui ana, e tukatuka ana i ngā kōnae ka tīpakohia e koe, kātahi ka tiakina tonutia ngā hua ki tō pūrere. Ko ō kōnae me ō rātou ihirangi kāore rawa e tukuna ake ki ō mātou tūmau, kāore mātou e pupuri i a rātou, ā, kāore e taea e mātou te kite. Ina katia, ina whakahouhia rānei e koe te whārangi, ka ngaro aua kōnae i te pūmahara o te pūtirotiro.

Ngā raraunga ka tukatukahia e mātou

  • Ngā raraunga hangarau. Pērā i te nuinga o ngā paetukutuku, ka tuhi tā mātou kaiwhakarato manaaki (Cloudflare) i ngā raraunga hangarau o ngā tono, pērā i te wāhitau IP, te momo pūtirotiro me te wā i toro mai ai, mō te haumarutanga me te whakahaere. Ka puritia ēnei pūkete mō te wā poto anake, e ai ki te kaupapa here a Cloudflare.
  • Ngā tatauranga tuhinga. Ka penapenahia ngā tatau o ngā tirohanga, ngā pai, me ngā tiritanga hei tapeke mō ia tuhinga, kāore he raraunga e tautuhi ana i a koe.

Ngā pihikete me te rokiroki i te pūtirotiro

  • inc-lang (localStorage): ka maumahara ki te reo i tīpakohia e koe. Ka noho tonu ēnei raraunga ki tō pūrere.
  • Ngā pihikete tātari a te hunga tuatoru mai i Google Analytics me Microsoft Clarity, e whakamāramatia ana i raro nei.
  • Te rokiroki ā-rohe (localStorage me sessionStorage): ka maumahara ki ngā tuhinga i pai ki a koe, ka ārai hoki kei tatauria kia rua tētahi toronga kotahi. Ka noho tonu ēnei raraunga ki tō pūrere.

Tātaritanga

Ka whakamahi mātou i ngā taputapu tātari kia mōhio ai mātou ki te āhua o te whakamahinga o te paetukutuku, kia whakapai ake ai hoki:

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): ka whakamahi pihikete hei ine i ngā whārangi ka huakina e koe, tō whenua (he whakatau tata), te momo o tō pūrere, me ngā takahanga pērā i ngā pāwhiri i ngā pātene tikiake. Ka tukatukahia ngā raraunga e Google i raro i te Kaupapahere Tūmataitinga a Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: ka utaina ina tīmata koe ki te pāhekoheko ki te whārangi. Ka hopu a Clarity i ngā pāhekohekotanga pērā i ngā pāwhiri me te panuku hei hanga mahere wera (heatmaps) me ngā hopukanga wātū, ā, ka hunaia ngā mea ka patohia e koe ki ngā āpure tāuru. Ka tukatukahia ngā raraunga e Microsoft i raro i te Tauākī Tūmataitinga a Microsoft.

Ka taea e koe te kōwhiri kia kaua e tātarihia mā te aukati i ngā pihikete a te hunga tuatoru i ngā tautuhinga o tō pūtirotiro, mā te whakamahi i tētahi kaiaukati aroturuki, mā te tāuta rānei i te Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Ka taea tonu te whakamahi i te paetukutuku katoa.

Ngā ratonga tuatoru

  • Ko Cloudflare, Inc. te kaiwhakarato manaaki. Tērā pea kei waho o Initonīhia ōna tūmau.
  • Ko jsDelivr te kaiwhakarato i te pūkaha hurihanga ataata, oro hoki. Ka tikiakehia tēnei pūkaha ki tō pūtirotiro i te wā tuatahi ka huri koe i tētahi ataata, oro rānei, nō reira ka kitea tō wāhitau IP e jsDelivr. Kāore ō kōnae e tukuna.
  • Ka whakamahia a Google Fonts hei whakaatu i ētahi pūnaha tuhituhi (hei tauira, te reo Arapia, te reo Tai, te reo Hapanihi rānei). Ina utaina ngā momotuhi, ka kitea tō wāhitau IP e Google.
  • Ko ngā pātene tiri (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) ka whakapā noa ki aua ratonga ina pāwhiritia e koe.

Te haumaru me te tiri raraunga

Ka whakamahi ngā hononga katoa ki tēnei paetukutuku i te HTTPS. Kāore mātou e hoko atu, e rīhi, e hokohoko rānei i ngā raraunga whaiaro. Ka tiria noatia ngā raraunga ki ngā kaiwhakarato ratonga kua whakahuatia i runga ake nei, ki te nui e hiahiatia ana hei whakahaere i te paetukutuku, ki te tonoa rānei e te ture.

Ngā tamariki

Ehara tēnei ratonga i te mea mō ngā tamariki kei raro iho i te 13 tau, ā, kāore mātou e kohi ā-whakaaro ana i ngā raraunga whaiaro o ngā tamariki.

Ō tika

E ai ki te Ture o Initonīhia Nama 27 o te tau 2022 mō te Tiaki Raraunga Whaiaro, e whai tika ana koe ki te tono kia uru atu, kia whakatikahia, kia mukua rānei ō raraunga whaiaro, me te tango anō i tō whakaaetanga kia tukatukahia aua raraunga. I te mea tata kore rawa he raraunga e puritia ana e mātou e mōhiotia ai ko koe, ka taea te whakaoti te nuinga o ngā tono mā te muku i ngā raraunga pae i ngā tautuhinga o tō pūtirotiro. Mō ētahi atu tono, whakapā mai.

Ngā panonitanga ki te kaupapa here

Ka taea te whakahou i tēnei kaupapa here i ngā wā katoa. Ka whai mana ngā panonitanga ina whakaputaina ki tēnei whārangi, me te rā whai mana kei runga ake.

Whakapā mai

Ka taea ngā pātai mō tēnei kaupapa here te tuku mā te hono whakapā kei raro o ia whārangi, mā abidhanan.my.id rānei.
terms.title: Ngā Ture & Ngā Tikanga
terms.description: Ngā ture me ngā tikanga mō te whakamahi i I Need Convert, he taputapu kore utu hei huri kōnae i te pūtirotiro.
terms.body:
Mā te whakamahi i I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com), e whakaae ana koe ki ēnei ture me ēnei tikanga e whai ake nei. Ki te kore koe e whakaae, tēnā koa kaua e whakamahi i tēnei ratonga.

Mō te ratonga

He taputapu kore utu a I Need Convert hei huri i ngā kōnae mai i tētahi hōputu ki tētahi atu. Ka mahia te hurihanga i tō pūtirotiro, nō reira kāore ngā kōnae e tukuna ake ki ō mātou tūmau. Kāore a I Need Convert e hono ana ki, e tautokohia ana e, e mahi tahi ana rānei me Apple, Microsoft, Google, Adobe, me tētahi atu kaipupuri hōputu, waitohu rānei. Nō ō rātou kaipupuri anō ngā waitohu hokohoko katoa.

Ngā whakamahinga e whakaaetia ana

  • Hurihia anake ngā kōnae nōu ake, ngā kōnae e whai whakaaetanga ana koe ki te whakamahi, ngā kōnae rānei e whakaaetia ana kia whakamahia e te ture e pā ana.
  • Ka taea e koe te whakamahi i tēnei ratonga mō ō take whaiaro, mō te mahi rānei, mēnā e hāngai ana ki ēnei ture.

Ō kōnae me tō haepapa

Ka noho tonu ngā kōnae ka hurihia e koe hei taonga nōu, nō te kaipupuri tika rānei. Kei a koe katoa te haepapa mō ngā kōnae ka tīpakohia e koe me te āhua o tō whakamahi i ngā hua o te hurihanga. Me pupuri tonu he tārua o te kōnae taketake i mua i te hurihanga.

Ngā mea e rāhuitia ana

  • Te huri, te tohatoha rānei i ngā ihirangi e takahi ana i te ture, i te manatārua, i te tūmataiti rānei o ētahi atu.
  • Te whakamahi i tēnei ratonga hei wawāhi i te parenga tārua (DRM), i ētahi atu herenga hangarau rānei.
  • Te whakamahi i ngā bot, i ngā hōtuhi (script), i te mahi aunoa rānei hei uru nui atu ki te ratonga.
  • Te whakararuraru, te whakataumaha, te ngana rānei ki te wawāhi i te haumaru o tō mātou paetukutuku me ā mātou ratonga.

Ngā hua o te hurihanga

Ka whakapau kaha mātou kia pai rawa ngā hua o te hurihanga, engari kāore e taea te huri tika rawa i ngā hōputu katoa. Ka rerekē, ka ngaro rānei te whakatakotoranga, ngā whakaahua, ngā ripanga, ngā tātai, ngā raraunga taunaki (metadata), te kounga rānei, i runga anō i te hōputu taketake me te hōputu ka puta. Tirohia ngā hua i mua i tō whakamahi mō ngā take hira.

Te wātea o te ratonga

Ka whakaratohia kore utu te ratonga, ā, ka taea te panoni, te whakawhāiti, te whakamutu rānei i ngā wā katoa, kāore he pānui i mua. Ka whakawhirinaki ētahi hōputu ki ngā āheinga o tō pūtirotiro me tō pūrere, nō reira kāore e wātea tonu ana ngā hurihanga katoa.

Whakakāhore kawenga

Ka whakaratohia te ratonga "i tōna āhua tonu" me te "i te wā e wātea ana", kāore he taurangi, tae atu ki te taurangi ka mahi tonu te ratonga, kāore he hapa, ka hāngai rānei ki tētahi take motuhake.

Te tepe o te haepapa

Ki te nui e whakaaetia ana e te ture, kāore mātou i te haepapa mō ngā ngaronga, ngā kino rānei, ahakoa tōtika, kāore rānei, ka puta mai i te whakamahinga o tēnei ratonga, tae atu ki te ngaro, te pakaru rānei o ngā raraunga me ngā kōnae.

Ngā hononga ki ngā tuatoru

Kei tēnei paetukutuku ngā hononga ki ngā pae me ngā ratonga tuatoru. Kāore mātou i te haepapa mō ngā ihirangi, mō ngā kaupapa here rānei o aua pae.

Ngā panonitanga ki ngā ture

Ka taea te whakahou i ēnei ture me ēnei tikanga i ngā wā katoa. Mā te whakamahi tonu i te ratonga i muri i te whakaputanga o ngā panonitanga, ka kīia kua whakaae koe ki te putanga hou rawa.

Te ture whakahaere

Ko ngā ture o te Repupirika o Initonīhia e whakahaere ana i ēnei ture me ēnei tikanga.

Whakapā mai

Ka taea ngā pātai me ngā pūrongo te tuku mā te hono whakapā kei raro o ia whārangi, mā abidhanan.my.id rānei. Pānuitia hoki tā mātou Kaupapa Here Tūmataiti.
